description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the setVideoWindow function in the Rialto client media pipeline. It uses Google Test framework to verify success and failure scenarios of setting the video window via IPC calls.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetVideoWindowTest
classes.description: A test fixture class derived from MediaPipelineTestBase, used to test the setVideoWindow functionality of the media pipeline.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys the media pipeline after each test.
